items.title: Jonah Delange Named Lou Groza Award Semifinalist
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB senior kicker Jonah Delange has been named one of 20 semifinalists for the 2026 Lou Groza Collegiate Place-Kicker Award presented by the Orange Bowl, the Palm Beach County Sports Commission announced Tuesday.

items.title: Blazers Turn Attention to UTSA for Senior Day at Protective Stadium
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – With bowl eligibility secured for the first time since 2022, the UAB football team returns to Protective Stadium on Saturday, Nov. 21, for a pivotal American Conference matchup against UTSA. Kickoff is scheduled for 7 p.m. CT on ESPNU.

items.title: UAB Football Season Finale at North Texas Set for 3 pm on ESPN U
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – The American Conference announced Monday that UAB football's regular-season finale at North Texas on Saturday, Nov. 28, will kick off at 3 p.m. CT and air nationally on ESPNU.

items.title: Dean Named American Defensive Player of the Week for Third Time; Robinson Earns Honorable Mention
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – For the third time this season, UAB defensive end Marlin Dean has been named the American Conference Defensive Player of the Week, the league announced Monday. Running back Rod Robinson II also earned honorable mention recognition following the Blazers' 36-10 victory at Temple on Saturday.

items.title: UAB Announces 7 p.m. Kickoff Against UTSA on ESPNU
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – The American Conference announced Sunday that UAB's regular-season home finale against UTSA on Saturday, Nov. 21, will kick off at 7 p.m. CT (8 p.m. ET) at Protective Stadium. The game will be televised nationally on ESPNU.

items.title: UAB Becomes Bowl Eligible With 36-10 Victory at Temple
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA, Pa. – Behind a career day from running back Rod Robinson II and another dominant defensive performance, the UAB football team defeated Temple 36-10 Saturday afternoon at Lincoln Financial Field to become bowl eligible for the first time since 2022.

items.title: UAB Travels to Temple Saturday Seeking Bowl Eligibility
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB returns to the road Saturday, Nov. 14, with an opportunity to become bowl eligible for the first time since 2022 as the Blazers travel to Philadelphia to face Temple in an American Conference matchup at Lincoln Financial Field. Kickoff is scheduled for noon CT (1 p.m. ET), with the game streaming on ESPN+.

items.title: Blazers Look to Carry Momentum Into Road Test at Temple
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – The UAB football team returns to the road Saturday, Nov. 14, with an opportunity to secure bowl eligibility as the Blazers travel to Philadelphia to face Temple in an American Conference matchup at Lincoln Financial Field.

items.title: Dean Earns Second American Conference Defensive Player of the Week Honor
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB defensive lineman Marlin Dean has been named the American Conference Defensive Player of the Week following a dominant performance in the Blazers' 23-12 victory over Charlotte, the league announced Monday.

items.title: UAB Pulls Away From Charlotte in Fourth Quarter for 23-12 Victory
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB scored 17 unanswered points in the fourth quarter and used another dominant defensive performance to defeat Charlotte, 23-12, Saturday afternoon at Protective Stadium in the 10th annual Children's Harbor Game.
